g.text: Tarvia SOC — Analytical data model (star schema)
Top two rows: log fact tables (event grain) · Middle: conformed dimensions + context facts · Bottom: alert fact, bridges and triage output · Edge colour = target dimension

g.title: legend
g.text: Attacker-controllable text (treat as data, never instructions)
user_key = lower(username); map upn, TARVIA\user, svc_* to it
Internal IP → dim_zone via CIDR range join; external IP → dim_ip
fact_change / fact_hr_event: join on entity + time window
All timestamps UTC; Madrid = UTC+2 (UTC+1 from 25-Oct)
